tournament.name: MTA S3 Championship Open - MTA Event

decks.notes: The deck focuses on utilizing powerful combo pieces like Fallaji Archaeologist, Hydroelectric Specimen, and Thundertrap Trainer to create a game-winning scenario without relying on traditional land cards. By utilizing cards like Disrupting Shoal and Sink into Stupor to disrupt the opponent's game plan, while also finding key pieces with cards like Whir of Invention and Sea Gate Restoration. This deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and execute a devastating combo before the opponent can respond effectively.

The deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures while utilizing blink effects to maximize their ETB triggers. This allows for efficient removal, disruption, and card advantage. The key strategy is to consistently apply pressure by repeatedly resetting key creatures such as Emperor of Bones and Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd with Flickerwisp and Ephemerate. The deck also includes powerful finishers like Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines and Graveyard Trespasser to seal games. Additionally, the inclusion of hand disruption and removal spells ensures the deck can efficiently disrupt the opponent's game plan.

The primary strategy of this Amulet Titan combo deck is to quickly ramp up mana with cards like Arboreal Grazer and Explore to play Primeval Titan and assemble a powerful board state. The deck utilizes cards like Amulet of Vigor and lands like Urza's Saga to generate extra value and enable explosive plays. With additional support cards like Scapeshift and Gruul Turf, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with overwhelming board presence and potentially finish off the game with Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and hand disruption. It also includes cards like Murktide Regent and Kaito, Bane of Nightmares for win conditions. The deck is designed to out-value the opponent by controlling the board and maintaining card advantage. The mana base is optimized for consistency and includes fetch lands to ensure the right colors of mana are available when needed. Overall, the deck aims to control the game until it can secure a victory through efficient removal and powerful threats.

The deck focuses on rapidly deploying cheap artifacts to enable powerful synergies and explosive plays. By utilizing cards like Mox Opal, Emry, Lurker of the Loch, and Thoughtcast, the deck aims to generate card advantage and ramp into threats like Pinnacle Emissary and Cori-Steel Cutter. With access to efficient removal spells like Galvanic Blast and Repeal, the deck can efficiently deal with opposing threats while maintaining its aggressive game plan. Additionally, cards like Urza's Saga and Mishra's Bauble provide additional value and utility to further support the deck's strategy.

The deck focuses on aggressive creatures backed up by burn spells and removal to quickly reduce the opponent's life total. It aims to establish a fast board presence with efficient creatures like Guide of Souls and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, while using burn spells like Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment to control the board and finish off the opponent. Cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Ocelot Pride provide additional buffs and support to overwhelm the opponent. The deck also includes some card advantage and graveyard recursion with Seasoned Pyromancer and Solitude to maintain pressure and close out games quickly.

The main concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to flood the board with aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nacatl Pariah, and Ocelot Pride while using burn spells like Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment to clear the way for attacks. Seasoned Pyromancer provides card advantage and token generation, while Static Prison helps control the opponent's board. Ajani and Voice of Victory provide additional support for the aggro strategy, making it difficult for the opponent to stabilize. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly and efficiently to secure a victory in the game.

This deck focuses on assembling the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Mine, Power Plant, and Tower) to generate a large amount of mana quickly. It utilizes control elements such as Karn, the Great Creator and Ugin, the Spirit Dragon to disrupt the opponent's strategy and protect the Tron lands. The deck also includes powerful creatures like Devourer of Destiny and Sire of Seven Deaths to apply pressure on the opponent. Overall, the key concept of this deck is to ramp up mana production with Tron lands and control the game until it can overwhelm the opponent with its threats.

The deck focuses on using aggressive creatures and direct damage spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. It utilizes a mix of powerful creatures like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and efficient spells like Lightning Bolt to apply pressure early in the game. The Leyline cards help to control the board while Tribal Flames provides additional reach for finishing off the opponent. The mana base is optimized to ensure consistency in casting spells and activating abilities. Overall, the deck aims to win fast and decisively through a combination of creature combat and burn spells.

The deck focuses on quickly building a board presence with low-cost artifact creatures and using cards like Cranial Plating and Shadowspear to boost their power and toughness. It also utilizes artifacts like Mox Opal and Urza's Saga to ramp up mana and generate value. The inclusion of Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Thought Monitor provides card advantage, while spells like Galvanic Blast and Metallic Rebuke offer removal and disruption. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and efficient aggro strategy centered around artifact synergy.

The deck focuses on quickly deploying aggressive creatures and burning spells to pressure the opponent. It aims to have a strong board presence early in the game and use its spells to remove threats or go for the opponent's life total. The deck's lineup of creatures and spells provides a mix of damage, resilience, and reach to close out games efficiently. The mana base is optimized to support the aggressive strategy and ensure consistency in casting spells. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with fast and relentless aggression.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly deploying aggressive creatures and using burn spells to control the board and pressure the opponent. Key cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer provide early threats, while cards like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Goblin Bombardment offer additional reach and damage. Seasoned Pyromancer helps to refill the hand and generate tokens, while Thraben Charm and Static Prison help to disrupt the opponent's game plan. With a mix of creature threats and burn spells, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and close out the game quickly.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with a combination of efficient creatures and burn spells. The key strategy is to apply pressure early with low-cost creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Ocelot Pride, while using burn spells like Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment to control the board and finish off opponents. Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Seasoned Pyromancer provide additional value and card advantage, while Fable of the Mirror-Breaker can be a game-winning finisher. The deck also includes some disruptive elements like Thraben Charm and Static Prison to disrupt opponents' game plans.

The focal point of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan through a combination of hand disruption, countermagic, and removal spells. By efficiently managing the opponent's resources and controlling the board with cards like Fatal Push and Counterspell, the deck aims to dictate the pace of the game and slowly grind out a victory. The deck also includes card draw and graveyard recursion to generate card advantage and maintain flexibility in various matchups. With a focus on controlling the game state, this deck seeks to outvalue opponents and secure a win through attrition.

The deck focuses on controlling the board with Eldrazi creatures and ramping up mana quickly to play powerful threats like Emrakul, the Promised End and World Breaker. It also utilizes cards like Kozilek's Return and Malevolent Rumble to control the opponent's creatures. The inclusion of Karn, the Great Creator allows for versatile gameplay options and Ugin, Eye of the Storm provides additional board control. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with large creatures and disruptive spells while using ramp to accelerate its game plan.

This Modern deck focuses on aggressively attacking opponents while utilizing blinking effects to protect key creatures and disrupt opponent's strategies. By playing cards like Overlord of the Balemurk and Witch Enchanter, the deck can quickly pressure the opponent while utilizing cards like Flickerwisp and Ephemerate to remove threats and create advantageous board states. With a mix of powerful creatures and disruptive spells like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents and secure a quick victory. Additionally, the mana base is carefully constructed to support the deck's aggressive gameplay plan.
